digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified gate and CI workflow
propositions: Zizmor workflow audit is scoped only to release.yml; gerrit-verify.yaml and _build-and-test.yml (vote-casting critical path workflows) are not audited, requiring zero-latency scope expansion via Makefile argument change.

SHA-pin assertion in gerrit-verify.yaml:21 is false; actions/setup-python@v7 and actions/checkout@v7 use mutable tags across gerrit-verify.yaml and _build-and-test.yml and must be replaced with SHA-pinned refs with version comments.
twine check dist/* metadata validation runs only at release time, not pre-merge; moving this validation into _artifact-probe.yml adds seconds of latency and catches packaging defects before merge.

Rebar enforces 70% branch coverage floor while urllib3 and cryptography enforce ~100%; implementing diff-coverage thresholds on changed lines reuses existing Ubuntu coverage data with near-zero added latency and achieves OSS-aligned practice without raising global floor.
